blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has apprehended an individual allegedly linked to the fatal school shooting in Banga, South Cotabato and a suspected online groomer in Cebu. NBI Director Melvin Matibag gave this information to senators on Thursday during a hearing on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Justice (DOJ). “Incidentally, I just want to report that yesterday, we were able to get one of the individuals who is somehow related to what happened in South Cotabato,” Matibag said The NBI chief did not provide further details about the individual or specify the nature of […]...
